## Documentation Issue

A clear and concise description of what documentation is missing, incorrect, or needs improvement.

## Location

Where is this documentation located (or where should it be)?

- [ ] README.md
- [ ] API Documentation
- [ ] Code Comments
- [ ] Setup/Installation Guide
- [ ] Contributing Guidelines
- [ ] Architecture Documentation
- [ ] Other: _______________

## Current State

Describe the current state of the documentation (if it exists).

## Desired State

Describe what the documentation should contain or how it should be improved.

## Affected Users

Who would benefit from this documentation improvement?

- [ ] New developers
- [ ] Existing contributors
- [ ] End users
- [ ] System administrators
- [ ] Other: _______________

## Additional Context

Add any other context, examples, or suggestions about the documentation improvement here.

## Priority

- [ ] 🔴 Critical (blocks development/usage)
- [ ] 🟡 High (significantly improves experience)
- [ ] 🟢 Medium (helpful improvement)
- [ ] 🔵 Low (minor enhancement)
